Spellplague is a hostile Countermeasure Aberration in Baldur's Gate 3.

Involvement

Spellplague may appear during the fight Atop the Netherbrain if the party side with the Emperor and a Wizard is present.

Combat

Actions and Abilities

 Absorb Intellect ()
Healing: 10~80
1d8⁠Healing
+ 2d8⁠Healing
+ 3d8⁠Healing
+ 4d8⁠Healing
Gobble up a foe's intellect, lowering their Intelligence by 1 per turn and healing your wounds for 5 turns.
 INT Save
 Range: 9 m (30 ft)
 Recharge: Short rest
 Counterspell ( + )

Try to stop a spell being cast.

If it is higher level than the spell slot you used to Counterspell, you must make a check using your spellcasting ability[See: Bugs] to prevent it. The check's difficulty is equal to 10 plus the level of the spell you are trying to counter.

This spell can be cast while you are  Silenced.

 Disintegrate ( + )
Damage: 50~100
10d6 + 40⁠Force
If the target fails a Dexterity  Saving Throw, and the spell reduces it to 0 hit points, it disintegrates into a crumbly ash.
 DEX Save
 Range: 9 m (30 ft)
 Ice Storm ( + )
Damage: 6~40
2d8⁠Bludgeoning
+ 4d6⁠Cold
Impel a storm of hail and ice to crash from the sky, covering the ground and striking all objects and creatures within range, dealing ⁠Bludgeoning and ⁠Cold damage. It also creates an  Ice surface that lasts 2 turns.
 DEX Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Magic Missile ( + )
Damage: 6~15
1d4 + 1⁠Force
+ 1d4 + 1⁠Force
+ 1d4 + 1⁠Force
Create three darts of magical force, each dealing 1d4 + 1⁠⁠Force damage to its target.

The darts always hit their target, and can each be targeted individually.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Dagger +2
Damage: 6~9
1d4 + 5⁠Piercing
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Polymorph ( + )

Transform a creature into a harmless sheep.

If the sheep's Hit Points drop to 0, the target reverts to its original form with its original Hit Points.

 WIS Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
